{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check how many times each patient_id appears
duplicate_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = duplicate_counts[duplicate_counts > 1]
print("\nPatient IDs appearing more than once:")
print(duplicates)

# Check sample_seq for the duplicated patients
duplicated_rows = data[data['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)]
duplicated_rows = duplicated_rows.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print("\nSample sequence for duplicated patients:")
print(duplicated_rows[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']])"}
